shard.name: Uptime Kuma
shard.description: Easy-to-use, fancy, self-hosted monitoring tool with status pages, uptime tracking, and notification integrations (Discord, Telegram, Webhook, etc.).
shard.author: Louis Lam & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Uptime Kuma Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apk add --no-cache curl jq tar git python3 make g++

cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p data

if [ -z "${UPTIME_KUMA_VERSION}" ] || [ "${UPTIME_KUMA_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo "Resolving latest Uptime Kuma release from GitHub..."
    UPTIME_KUMA_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/louislam/uptime-kuma/releases/latest | jq -r .tag_name)
fi

echo "Downloading Uptime Kuma release ${UPTIME_KUMA_VERSION}..."
curl -sSL "https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma/archive/refs/tags/${UPTIME_KUMA_VERSION}.tar.gz" | tar -xz --strip-components=1

echo "Installing dependencies..."
npm install --production
npm run download-dist

echo "Uptime Kuma setup complete!"
